A separate R2010 binary-to-ASCII control retains a tilted IMAGE's base and pixel axes. All four audits report zero errors and zero fixes.
The adapter syntax-checks with older bundled codec headers; runtime behavior against those headers is not qualified.
limits: The tested drawings are locally authored and cover selected same-revision R2000 and R2010 graphs. Raw IMAGEDEF/reactor metadata and original image-dictionary identity are still omitted and reported; this is not whole-file lossless replay.
Other plot styles, classes, text/codepages, graph shapes, source producers, native rendering and platforms remain unqualified. Generated outputs are not committed.
